import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

ALLOWED_ISLANDS = ["Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"]

def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # normalize island label variants (case / trailing spaces)
    def norm_island(v):
        if pd.isna(v):
            return np.nan
        s = str(v).strip()
        for a in ALLOWED_ISLANDS:
            if s.lower() == a.lower():
                return a
        return s
    d["island"] = d["island"].map(norm_island)

    # body_mass_g written as text with thousands separators
    d["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(
        d["body_mass_g"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors="coerce",
    )
    # enforce valid range for body mass
    d.loc[~d["body_mass_g"].between(2500, 6500), "body_mass_g"] = np.nan

    # flipper_length_mm: sign errors (negatives) and out-of-range values
    fl = pd.to_numeric(d["flipper_length_mm"], errors="coerce")
    fl = fl.abs()  # fix sign errors like -228 -> 228
    fl[~fl.between(170, 235)] = np.nan
    d["flipper_length_mm"] = fl

    # bill_length_mm range check
    bl = pd.to_numeric(d["bill_length_mm"], errors="coerce")
    bl[~bl.between(30, 60)] = np.nan
    d["bill_length_mm"] = bl

    # sex: leave missing as unknown (do not guess)
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["species", "body_mass_g"])
    g = d.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
